title: Building Macroeconomically Relevant Climate Indices via the Assemblage VAR
hypothesis: Assembled MRCI climate index (component-space and rank-space) yields materially larger and statistically significant contractionary impulse responses (up to twice benchmark) and reveals economically interpretable weight profiles (high-wind/thermal extremes and distributional tails vs slow-moving sea level/cold).
data_sources: Actuaries Climate Index ACI U.S. portion (6 components T90,T10,Rx5Day,CDD,WP90,sea level, 5-year smoothed headline; event-oriented analogue built from month-on-month changes standardized to 1961--1990)
NOAA weather/atmospheric dataset 82 series across 10 U.S. zones + Mauna Loa CO2 level/trend, plus 4 Palmer drought indices PDSI,PHDI,PMDI,Palmer Z-index
FRED-MD macro series INDPRO,PCEPI,UNRATE,EXUSUKx,HOUST; WuXia2016 shadow rate; data vintage 1975-2025
sample: U.S. monthly time series. Estimation sample 1975:M1 to 2025:M4 excluding COVID-19 period 2020:M1--2021:M6. Effective sample n = T - p where p=12 VAR lags. Panel definitions: ACI U.S. portion 6 components (T90,T10,Rx5Day,CDD,WP90,sea level) - CDD excluded from estimation (annual interpolated); National specification d=5 ACI national components; Regional specification d=34 =5 components x7 regions (Midwest no sea level); NOAA specification d=82 across 10 zones incl. Mauna Loa CO2. All constituents standardized to zero mean month-on-month changes using 1961--1990 moments; assembled index x_t*(w)=w'X_t (component-space) or w'O_t rank-space with O_t=sort(X_t). VAR state y_t(w) dimension k=7: climate index + INDPRO (log-diff), PCEPI (log-diff), UNRATE (first-diff), SHADOWRATE (level, WuXia2016), EXUSUKx (log-diff), HOUST (log-diff) - FRED-MD except shadow rate. n = not stated numerically in text (T minus p minus COVID window); d counts as above are the sample-size counts printed.
method: 1. Panel construction: for each ACI component X_{j,t} compute month-on-month changes and standardize using 1961--1990 moments; exclude CDD (annual interpolated) to avoid exploiting mechanical predictability; build three panels National d=5, Regional d=34 (7 regions), NOAA d=82 (10 zones).

2. Assemblage definition: replace benchmark x_t with x_t*(w)=w'X_t (component-space eq.1) or x_t*(w)=w'O_t with O_t=sort(X_t) (rank-space eq.6); impose simplex w>=0, 1'w=1; mean anchoring holds automatically because constituents zero-mean.

3. Learning criterion: for fixed w estimate reduced-form VAR(p) y_t(w)=nu(w)+sum_{j=1}^p A_j(w) y_{t-j}(w)+u_t(w) with Sigma(w) via equation-by-equation OLS: Y(w)=Z(w)B(w)+U(w) with n=T-p rows; quasi-log-likelihood ell_T(B,Sigma;w) Gaussian; criterion S_T(w)=hat ell_{1,T}(w)-hat ell_{0,T}(w) vs mean-only benchmark mu(w) (eq.5); population target maximizes half log generalized variance ratio |Sigma0*|/|Sigma1*|.

4. Regularized estimator: w_hat(lambda)=argmin_{w in simplex} -S_T(w)+lambda*pen(w); component-space pen=||w-w_ref||2^2 with w_ref equal-weight ACI 20% (eq.7); rank-space pen=||D w||2^2 fused ridge smoothing adjacent ranks (eq.8, D first-difference); unpenalized target w*=argmin -S(w) on simplex.

5. Penalty selection: lambda_hat selected by 5-fold non-overlapping block CV: divide sample into 5 contiguous blocks, hold out one, estimate w^(-m)(lambda) on 4 blocks, compute fold-specific S_Tm^(m) on held-out VAR, maximize average; lambda_hat then fixed for bootstrap (fixed-tuning convention sec. Penalty_selection).

6. Optimization: SQP via NlcOptim::solnl in R with lower bound >=0, linear equality sum w=1 (and mean equality where binding); warm start at benchmark equal weights; verified stability from random simplex starts.

7. VAR specification: order climate index first (contemporaneous exogeneity, Cholesky) - same as KimMatthesPhan2025; p=12; transforms: log-differences INDPRO,PCEPI,EXUSUKx,HOUST, first-difference UNRATE, level SHADOWRATE; estimate B_hat Sigma_hat conditional on w_hat(lambda_hat).

8. Structural IRF: one-std innovation to own assembled index x_t*(w_hat) via Cholesky; recursive identification unchanged but innovation defined separately per specification; impulse responses reported cumulative except interest rate; comparison across equal-weight benchmark vs 6 assembled specifications (comp + rank x 3 granularities).

9. Inference main-text: fixed-weights residual bootstrap 68% equal-tailed percentile-t intervals conditional on lambda_hat w_hat: center residuals, resample overlapping blocks ell=floor(n^{1/3})=8 retaining contemporaneous dependence; B_outer=1,000 artificial series recursive from estimated VAR with p=12 initial rows; refit VAR; quantiles q_h of (theta*_b - theta_hat)/sigma*_b; sigma*_b from B_inner=100, sigma_hat from 200; redraw up to 50 if companion eigenvalue >=1; set.seed(123).

10. Robustness: weight-reestimating pairs bootstrap (B=1,000) at fixed lambda_hat: form aligned y/Z pairs, resample overlapping blocks ell=max{p+1,floor(T^{1/3})}=13; re-estimate w and VAR jointly per replication starting at w_hat; VAR fit; pointwise 68% basic intervals [2 theta_hat - q*0.84, 2 theta_hat - q*0.16] not studentized; percentile intervals for weights respecting simplex; also expanding-window re-estimation 2005--2025 COVID window held at Dec2019 value to trace weight stability.
